# Security Checklist: SPEC-013B - Claim and Reconciliation Authority

**Purpose**: Validate security requirement quality for feature-flag discipline, GitHub/task identifier validation, redacted claim evidence, read-only boundaries, and scheduler-safe error handling
**Created**: 2026-05-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are feature-flag security requirements defined so SPEC-013B behavior is gated only through `resolveFlag('FEATURE_TASK_CONTROL_PLANE', ctx)`? [Completeness, Spec §Project Constraints, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [x] CHK002 Are GitHub repository identifier validation requirements defined with an exact accepted format rather than the vague term `valid github_repo`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Data Model §GitHub Issue-Linked Task, Contract §Identifier And Release Vocabularies]
- [x] CHK003 Are positive GitHub issue and pull-request number requirements documented for autonomous claim intake and read-model exposure? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications, Data Model §GitHub Issue-Linked Task]
- [x] CHK004 Are evidence allowlist requirements defined for claim metadata, activity payloads, task-stage attempt event metadata, and read-model responses? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, Data Model §Reconciliation Decision, Contract §Contract Rules]
- [x] CHK005 Are secret-bearing input classes explicitly excluded from persistence and exposure? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, Plan §Evidence Safety, Contract §Contract Rules]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the flag-off security boundary clear that read models may inspect history but must not acquire, release, recover, defer, or write evidence? [Clarity, Plan §API, Contract §Flag-Off Response]
- [x] CHK007 Is `FEATURE_TASK_CONTROL_PLANE` resolution stated as an API call requirement rather than an inline environment-variable or process-env check? [Clarity, Plan §Constraints, Module Contract §Responsibilities]
- [x] CHK008 Are redaction and rejection expectations stated for raw prompts, tokens, auth headers, raw provider responses, gateway/session payloads, secret-shaped values, and matched secret substrings? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Data Model §Safety Rules]
- [x] CHK009 Are read-only route authorization and workspace scoping requirements specified for the task-scoped claim evidence endpoint? [Clarity, Data Model §Claim Reconciliation Read Model, Contract §Auth]
- [x] CHK010 Are scheduler boundary, retry, and transaction-error classification requirements defined so concurrent/retry failures fail closed for one task, redact diagnostics, preserve the scheduler tick, and cannot bypass governance? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, Plan §Boundary Error Classification]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Do structured activity requirements consistently use a closed claim/reconciliation taxonomy across the spec, data model, API contract, and plan? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Data Model §Reconciliation Decision, Contract §Read Model States And Reasons]
- [x] CHK012 Are business deferrals consistently represented as read-model states instead of transport authorization errors? [Consistency, Contract §Read Model States And Reasons, Contract §Error Responses]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK015 Can flag-off parity be objectively measured by unchanged legacy dispatch side effects and absence of claim/reconciliation writes? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-005, Plan §Verification Plan]
- [x] CHK016 Can payload safety be objectively measured by tests that reject or redact unsafe fields and secret-shaped values? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-007, Module Contract §Required Tests]

- [x] CHK018 Can duplicate active claim prevention be objectively measured without exposing raw database constraint details in activities or API responses? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001, Plan §Verification Plan]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK019 Are concurrent scheduler tick scenarios covered without allowing duplicate launch handoff or duplicated active claims? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, Plan §Verification Plan]
- [x] CHK020 Are stale-owner release attempts covered so late releases cannot mutate replacement claims or expose stale owner diagnostics? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Plan §Verification Plan]
- [x] CHK021 Are terminal GitHub issue and linked PR states covered as non-claimable or release-triggering reconciliation outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §Clarifications, Plan §GitHub Truth Freshness]
- [x] CHK022 Are malformed, missing, or stale GitHub truth scenarios required to defer launch without live GitHub fetches inside the active-claim transaction? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Project Constraints, Plan §GitHub Truth Freshness]
- [x] CHK023 Are unauthorized or invisible task read-model scenarios separated from visible business deferrals? [Coverage, Contract §Error Responses, Contract §Read Model States And Reasons]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK025 Are assumptions about locally persisted GitHub truth documented so external tracker credentials or provider payloads are not introduced into the claim transaction? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §GitHub Truth Freshness]
